name: power-system-academic-radar
description: Track, score, deduplicate, and summarize power-system configuration and optimal-dispatch literature from public APIs, RSS feeds, IEEE API access, and manual IEEE/CNKI exports.

interface.shortDescription: Monitor power-system papers across IEEE, CNKI exports, public APIs, and RSS.
interface.longDescription: A local academic radar for power system configuration, planning, operation, optimal dispatch, OPF, unit commitment, network reconfiguration, integrated energy systems, microgrids, storage, and demand response. It provides a Codex skill, a Python runner, and a local drag-and-drop configuration console with safe credential boundaries.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the power-system literature radar to configure keywords, sources, and run a digest.
